firm_data.firm_description: Kirschenbaum & Kirschenbaum, P.C., founded in 1977, is a mid-size general practice law firm on Long Island. The firm provides legal advice and services, maintaining diversity in its practice and representing various clients in different industries.
notable_facts: Kenneth Kirschenbaum is a renowned expert in the Security Industry and developed the 'industry contracts'.
Jennifer Kirschenbaum is a recognized expert in healthcare law.
K&K's healthcare department represents healthcare practitioners in regulatory compliance, licensure, insurance matters, investigations, patient issues and all contracts.

email.subject: AI for Kirschenbaum & Kirschenbaum, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jennifer,

I noticed K&K's deep expertise in healthcare law and regulatory compliance work. That's exactly where we're seeing the biggest efficiency gains with our AI platform.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Garden City office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
